description_en: Calls the UpdateVpcGatewayEndpointAttribute operation to update the configuration of a VPC gateway endpoint
description_zh: 调用UpdateVpcGatewayEndpointAttribute接口修改网关终端节点的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc update-vpc-gateway-endpoint-attribute --endpoint-id vpce-bp1w1dmdqjpwul0v30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVpcGatewayEndpointAttribute

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the gateway endpoint whose configuration you want to update
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改信息的网关终端节点的实例ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the gateway endpoint.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
网关终端节点需要被修改的名称。

名称的长度在1~128个字符之间
parameters.name: endpoint_name

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the gateway endpoint.

The description must be 1 to 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
网关终端节点需要被修改的描述信息。

描述信息的长度在1~255个字符之间
parameters.name: endpoint_description

parameters.help_en:
The access policy for the cloud service.

For more information about the syntax and structure of access policies, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93739.html
parameters.help_zh:
云服务的访问策略。

关于访问策略的语法和结构，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93739.html
parameters.name: policy_document

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without updating the gateway endpoint configuration. The system checks the AccessKey pair, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and the required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): sends a Normal request. If the check succeeds, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the gateway endpoint configuration is updated
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改网关终端节点的信息。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并修改网关终端节点的信息
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the gateway endpoint whose configuration you want to update.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改信息的网关终端节点所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
